 t,xi,z=S.symbols('t xi z');sig=S.Rational(801,200);jets=S.symbols('e0:8')

 A=[arb(x) for x in ans['cutoff_derivative_guards']]
 W=[arb(x) for x in ['895','4.48','4.5','18.1','4.48','4.5','18.1','1.206e18']]

 for exact,wide in zip(Cb,[W[0],W[1],W[2],W[3],W[7]]):assert exact<wide
 def rat(v):return arb(int(v.p))/int(v.q)
 DN=[]
 for n,form in enumerate(T):
  coeff={};bound=arb(0)

   poly=S.Poly(S.expand(form).coeff(e),t,xi)
   for (power,deriv),co in poly.terms():

 f=S.Function('f')(z);base=z**5*S.diff(f,z);outputs=[]
 for l in range(4):

   c=S.simplify(expr.coeff(S.diff(f,z,j+1))/z**(5+j));row.append(c)
   assert c==S.Rational(ans['output_polynomials'][l][j])
  outputs.append(row);base=S.expand(z*S.diff(base,z)-sig*base)
 a=arb('.01');near=arb(0)
 for l in range(4):

   for k in range(4):
    near+=arb(comb(3,l)).sqrt()*rat(abs(c))*((5+j-rat(sig))*arb(2).log()).exp()*arb(comb(3,k)).sqrt()*(a/2)**(4-k)*DN[1+j+k]

 for kind in ['planning','satellite']:

 m['scientific_frozen_sha256']={f:sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in sorted(set(files))};mf.write_bytes((json.dumps(m,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
